RupeeRadar

A clearer picture of everyday spending.

PROJECT CONTEXTPersonal learning project

The question

Bank statements record what happened. Understanding the patterns still takes work. RupeeRadar explores how raw transactions can become categorized spending insights, recurring-expense patterns, and a more understandable financial picture.

My project description documents statement ingestion, recurring-expense detection, an interactive dashboard, and personalized recommendations. The README preview also describes a rules-first categorization approach, with AI used for ambiguous transactions.

The business analysis lens

The useful part is the connection between a data question and a decision. A category total is a starting point; the next question is whether that category makes sense, whether the data is complete, and what a person can reasonably conclude from it.

  • Data quality: inconsistent transaction descriptions can change how spending is categorized.
  • Explainability: a useful summary should let someone trace a total back to its transactions.
  • Judgment: a recurring payment is not automatically an unnecessary payment.

Try a small example

The portfolio includes a six-transaction example with computed category totals. It is an explanatory reconstruction using synthetic data, not a recording or embedded version of RupeeRadar.
